# Folkbench 中转站实测评测，与 Folkbench Switch。 [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Folkbench/folkbench?include_prereleases&label=release&color=7624f4&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Folkbench/folkbench/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Folkbench/folkbench?color=f5a623&logo=github&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Folkbench/folkbench/stargazers) [![folkbench.com](https://img.shields.io/badge/folkbench.com-533afd?style=for-the-badge&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://folkbench.com/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=readme_badge) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-2BA2E0?logo=telegram&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://t.me/+C_E8eL1ZevM4MTY9) [![Group](https://img.shields.io/badge/Group-12B7F5?logo=qq&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://qm.qq.com/q/71NzSTrPVK) [🌐 在线评测大盘](https://folkbench.com/rankings/board?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=readme) · [⚡ Switch 客户端](#folkbench-switch) · [📦 下载安装](https://github.com/Folkbench/folkbench/releases) · [🔥 热门模型](#热门模型) · [💬 交流群 (TG)](https://t.me/+C_E8eL1ZevM4MTY9) · [💬 QQ 群](https://qm.qq.com/q/71NzSTrPVK) · [English](README.en.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Español](README.es.md)

[folkbench.com](https://folkbench.com/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=readme) 持续测试各家 AI 中转站，公开可用率、响应耗时和价格。本仓库是配套桌面客户端 **Folkbench Switch** 的代码，用来把选好的线路写入 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的配置。 --- ## 赞助商 以下中转站支持 Folkbench 的持续评测。[成为赞助商 →](https://folkbench.com/vendor/login?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=readme)
Modelflare
Modelflare站点是由美国 Havenbyte LLC 运营，支持 GPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 等主流模型和常用兼容协议，同时也支持 40 多种图片及视频模型。API Key
